title: The RBC Client Relief Program
description: The RBC Client Relief Program provides immediate & long-term financial assistance to our clients who have been impacted by COVID-19. rbc.com/covid19

asr.full_text: RBC clients we want you to know even when we're apart we stand together. We stand together as Canadians united by caring, compassion and our sense of community. We know these are challenging times and we'll provide the support you need. That's why we've created the RBC Client Relief Program to help you get through this. Through payment deferrals you can defer payments on mortgages, loans, and credit card balances with no impact on your credit score. We're also offering hardship relief for personal and business clients who are struggling due to lost jobs or income, which may include help with reducing credit card interest charges, refinancing, and credit restructuring. As we face these challenges, we will evolve our approach because in this time when we must remain apart, it's more important than ever that we be there for each other. Everything you need to know about the RBC Client Relief Program can be found at rbc.com slash COVID19

Its stated purpose is informational and directs viewers to an RBC COVID-19 webpage for more details, with no described payment or credential request.
